description: Report this machine's Claude Code limits: 5-hour and weekly percent used, reset times, and Codex limits if present. Use when: the user asks how much quota is left, or before heavy Claude Code work; at 90% or more, pass after_limit_reset to schedule_task. Do not use for task state (use check_queue_status). Behavior: reads the statusline reading, no API key; TIDEGAP_USAGE_OAUTH=1 calls the usage endpoint with the Claude Code login and caches it in ~/.tidegap/usage.json; never writes tasks or settings. Returns: a summary line and the usage/v1 JSON (windows, reading age, after_limit_reset wait).

include_spend.description: true adds claude_spend: tokens and an API list-price cost estimate for the current 5-hour window from the local Claude Code logs (total, by model, the five latest sessions), plus the tokens of recent Codex sessions. Use it when the user asks what their usage would cost; the scan takes a few seconds. Defaults to false.

name: tidegap_usage
